query:
SELECT hs_sec.id, hs_sec.htlcId, hs_sec.chain, hs_sec.status, hs_sec.locktime, hs_sec.settledVia, hs_sec.createdAt,
       FROM_UNIXTIME(hs_sec.locktime) as locktime_human,
       CASE WHEN hs_sec.locktime < UNIX_TIMESTAMP() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE CONCAT('active ~', ROUND((hs_sec.locktime - UNIX_TIMESTAMP())/60), 'min left') END as timelock_state
FROM htlc_secrets hs_sec
WHERE hs_sec.status = 'pending' AND hs_sec.chain = 'solana'
ORDER BY hs_sec.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
